sources.title: Council Tax Manual - Council Tax: practice notes
sources.verified_claim: The current technical manual explains the statutory basis and valuation practice for domestic Council Tax, including England's band thresholds and the 1 April 1991 valuation basis. This is not a current market valuation of a sample parcel.

sources.title: Council Tax Manual - Section 1: introduction and essential background
sources.verified_claim: The manual documents the legal and administrative framework for maintaining Council Tax valuation lists; general procedure is not an exact candidate band.

sources.title: Council Tax: stock of properties, 2025
sources.verified_claim: Official statistics provide band and property-attribute stock counts and note minor methodological differences after the new valuation operating system. Aggregate stock is not candidate band evidence.

sources.title: 2026 Valuation Office statistics announcements
sources.verified_claim: The release schedule records the staged rebuilding of Council Tax stock and challenge statistics after the 2025 system migration; future tables are not treated as already available.

sources.title: Council Tax: stock of properties statistical commentary
sources.verified_claim: The commentary reports stock by band and property attributes as at 31 March 2025 and retains methodology-change caveats. Borough or national distributions cannot identify an individual dwelling band.

sources.title: How Council Tax works
sources.verified_claim: Council Tax liability depends on the exact home's valuation band, local authority charge and discounts/exemptions; structural and use changes can affect banding.

sources.title: Council Tax band challenge form
sources.verified_claim: The current challenge process requires standing to act and supporting evidence. Availability of a challenge process does not imply the current band of a sample candidate is wrong or known.

sources.title: How domestic properties are assessed for Council Tax bands
sources.verified_claim: England's Council Tax bands are assessed against 1 April 1991 open-market values using dwelling characteristics and statutory assumptions; an exact property lookup is still required for a candidate band.
